verses.en: Woe to thee that spoilest, and thou wast not spoiled; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! when thou shalt cease to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled; and when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee.
verses.pt: Ai de ti que despojas, e que não foste despojado; e que procedes perfidamente, e que não foste tratado perfidamente! quando acabares de destruir, serás destruído; e, quando acabares de tratar perfidamente, perfidamente te tratarão.
verses.en_web: Woe to you who destroy, but you weren’t destroyed; and who betray, but nobody betrayed you! When you have finished destroying, you will be destroyed; and when you have finished betrayal, you will be betrayed.
verses.en_bbe: Ho! you who make waste those who did not make you waste; acting falsely to those who were not false to you. When you have come to an end of wasting, you will be made waste, and after your false acts, they will do the same to you.

verses.en: O LORD, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
verses.pt: ç Senhor, tem misericórdia de nós; por ti temos esperado. Sê tu o nosso braço cada manhã, como também a nossa salvação no tempo da tribulação.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, be gracious to us. We have waited for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord, have mercy on us; for we have been waiting for your help: be our strength every morning, our salvation in time of trouble.

verses.en: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.
verses.pt: Ao ruído do tumulto fogem os povos; à tua exaltação as nações são dispersas.
verses.en_web: At the noise of the thunder, the peoples have fled. When you lift yourself up, the nations are scattered.
verses.en_bbe: At the loud noise the peoples have gone in flight; at your coming up the nations have gone in all directions.

verses.en: And your spoil shall be gathered like the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them.
verses.pt: Então ajuntar-se-á o vosso despojo como ajunta a lagarta; como os gafanhotos saltam, assim sobre ele saltarão os homens.
verses.en_web: Your plunder will be gathered as the caterpillar gathers. Men will leap on it as locusts leap.
verses.en_bbe: And the goods taken in war will be got together like the massing of young locusts; men will be rushing on them like the rushing of locusts.

verses.en: The LORD is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.
verses.pt: O Senhor é exalçado, pois habita nas alturas; encheu a Sião de retidão e justiça.
verses.en_web: Yahweh is exalted, for he dwells on high. He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is lifted up; his place is on high: he has made Zion full of righteousness and true religion.

verses.en: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, and strength of salvation: the fear of the LORD is his treasure.
verses.pt: Será ele a estabilidade dos teus tempos, abundância de salvação, sabedoria, e conhecimento; e o temor do Senhor é o seu tesouro.
verses.en_web: There will be stability in your times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of Yahweh is your treasure.
verses.en_bbe: And she will have no more fear of change, being full of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge: the fear of the Lord is her wealth.

verses.en: Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.
verses.pt: Eis que os valentes estão clamando de fora; e os embaixadores da paz estão chorando amargamente.
verses.en_web: Behold, their valiant ones cry outside; the ambassadors of peace weep bitterly.
verses.en_bbe: See, the men of war are sorrowing outside the town: those who came looking for peace are weeping bitterly.

verses.en: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: he hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth no man.
verses.pt: As estradas estão desoladas, cessam os que passam pelas veredas; alianças se rompem, testemunhas se desprezam, e não se faz caso dos homens.
verses.en_web: The highways are desolate. The traveling man ceases. The covenant is broken. He has despised the cities. He doesn’t respect man.
verses.en_bbe: The highways are waste, no man is journeying there: the agreement is broken, he has made sport of the towns, he has no thought for man.

verses.en: The earth mourneth and languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed and hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off their fruits.
verses.pt: A terra pranteia, desfalece; o Líbano se envergonha e se murcha; Sarom se tornou como um deserto; Basã e Carmelo ficam despidos de folhas.
verses.en_web: The land mourns and languishes. Lebanon is confounded and withers away. Sharon is like a desert, and Bashan and Carmel are stripped bare.
verses.en_bbe: The earth is sorrowing and wasting away; Lebanon is put to shame and has become waste; Sharon is like the Arabah; and in Bashan and Carmel the leaves are falling.

verses.en: Now will I rise, saith the LORD; now will I be exalted; now will I lift up myself.
verses.pt: Agora me levantarei, diz o Senhor; agora me erguerei; agora serei exaltado.
verses.en_web: “Now I will arise,” says Yahweh; “Now I will lift myself up. Now I will be exalted.
verses.en_bbe: Now will I come forward, says the Lord; now will I be lifted up; now will my power be seen.

verses.en: Ye shall conceive chaff, ye shall bring forth stubble: your breath, as fire, shall devour you.
verses.pt: Concebeis palha, produzis restolho; e o vosso fôlego é um fogo que vos devorará.
verses.en_web: You will conceive chaff. You will give birth to stubble. Your breath is a fire that will devour you.
verses.en_bbe: Your designs will be without profit, and their effect will be nothing: you will be burned up by the fire of my breath.

verses.en: And the people shall be as the burnings of lime: as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.
verses.pt: E os povos serão como as queimas de cal, como espinhos cortados que são queimados no fogo.
verses.en_web: The peoples will be like the burning of lime, like thorns that are cut down and burned in the fire.
verses.en_bbe: And the peoples will be like the burning of chalk: as thorns cut down, which are burned in the fire.

verses.en: Hear, ye that are far off, what I have done; and, ye that are near, acknowledge my might.
verses.pt: Ouvi, vós os que estais longe, o que tenho feito; e vós, que estais vizinhos, reconhecei o meu poder.
verses.en_web: Hear, you who are far off, what I have done; and, you who are near, acknowledge my might.”
verses.en_bbe: Give ear, you who are far off, to what I have done: see my power, you who are near.

verses.en: The sinners in Zion are afraid; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites. Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?
verses.pt: Os pecadores de Sião se assombraram; o tremor apoderou-se dos ímpios. Quem dentre nós pode habitar com o fogo consumidor? quem dentre nós pode habitar com as labaredas eternas?
verses.en_web: The sinners in Zion are afraid. Trembling has seized the godless ones. Who among us can live with the devouring fire? Who among us can live with everlasting burning?
verses.en_bbe: The sinners in Zion are full of fear; the haters of God are shaking with wonder. Who among us may keep his place before the burning fire? who among us may see the eternal burnings?

verses.en: He that walketh righteously, and speaketh uprightly; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil;
verses.pt: Aquele que anda em justiça, e fala com retidão; aquele que rejeita o ganho da opressão; que sacode as mãos para não receber peitas; o que tapa os ouvidos para não ouvir falar do derramamento de sangue, e fecha os olhos para não ver o mal;
verses.en_web: He who walks righteously, and speaks blamelessly; He who despises the gain of oppressions, who gestures with his hands, refusing to take a bribe, who stops his ears from hearing of blood, and shuts his eyes from looking at evil—
verses.en_bbe: He whose ways are true, and whose words are upright; he who gives no thought to the profits of false acts, whose hands have not taken rewards, who will have no part in putting men to death, and whose eyes are shut against evil;

verses.en: He shall dwell on high: his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters shall be sure.
verses.pt: este habitará nas alturas; as fortalezas das rochas serão o seu alto refúgio; dar-se-lhe-á o seu pão; as suas águas serão certas.
verses.en_web: he will dwell on high. His place of defense will be the fortress of rocks. His bread will be supplied. His waters will be sure.
verses.en_bbe: He will have a place on high: he will be safely shut in by the high rocks: his bread will be given to him; his waters will be certain.

verses.en: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off.
verses.pt: Os teus olhos verão o rei na sua formosura, e verão a terra que se estende em amplidão.
verses.en_web: Your eyes will see the king in his beauty. They will see a distant land.
verses.en_bbe: Your eyes will see the king in his glory: they will be looking on a far-stretching land.

verses.en: Thine heart shall meditate terror. Where is the scribe? where is the receiver? where is he that counted the towers?
verses.pt: O teu coração meditará no terror, dizendo: Onde está aquele que serviu de escrivão? onde está o que pesou o tributo? onde está o que contou as torres?
verses.en_web: Your heart will meditate on the terror. Where is he who counted? Where is he who weighed? Where is he who counted the towers?
verses.en_bbe: Your heart will give thought to the cause of your fear: where is the scribe, where is he who made a record of the payments, where is he by whom the towers were numbered?

verses.en: Thou shalt not see a fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than thou canst perceive; of a stammering tongue, that thou canst not understand.
verses.pt: Não verás mais aquele povo feroz, povo de fala obscura, que não se pode compreender, e de língua tão estranha que não se pode entender.
verses.en_web: You will no longer see the fierce people, a people of a deep speech that you can’t comprehend, with a strange language that you can’t understand.
verses.en_bbe: Never again will you see the cruel people, a people whose tongue has no sense for you; whose language is strange to you.

verses.en: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle that shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.
verses.pt: Olha para Sião, a cidade das nossas festas solenes; os teus olhos verão a Jerusalém, habitação quieta, tenda que não será removida, cujas estacas nunca serão arrancadas, e das suas cordas nenhuma se quebrará.
verses.en_web: Look at Zion, the city of our appointed festivals. Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a quiet habitation, a tent that won’t be removed. Its stakes will never be plucked up, nor will any of its cords be broken.
verses.en_bbe: Let your eyes be resting on Zion, the town of our holy feasts: you will see Jerusalem, a quiet resting-place, a tent which will not be moved, whose tent-pins will never be pulled up, and whose cords will never be broken.

verses.en: But there the glorious LORD will be unto us a place of broad rivers and streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.
verses.pt: Mas o Senhor ali estará conosco em majestade, nesse lugar de largos rios e correntes, no qual não entrará barco de remo, nem por ele passará navio grande.
verses.en_web: But there Yahweh will be with us in majesty, a place of wide rivers and streams, in which no galley with oars will go, neither will any gallant ship pass by there.
verses.en_bbe: But there the Lord will be with us in his glory, ... wide rivers and streams; where no boat will go with blades, and no fair ship will be sailing.

verses.en: For the LORD is our judge, the LORD is our lawgiver, the LORD is our king; he will save us.
verses.pt: Porque o Senhor é o nosso juiz; o Senhor é nosso legislador; o Senhor é o nosso rei; ele nos salvará.
verses.en_web: For Yahweh is our judge. Yahweh is our lawgiver. Yahweh is our king. He will save us.
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord is our judge, the Lord is our law-giver, the Lord is our king; he will be our saviour.

verses.en: Thy tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey.
verses.pt: As tuas cordas ficaram frouxas; elas não puderam ter firme o seu mastro, nem servir para estender a vela; então a presa de abundantes despojos se repartirá; e ate os coxos participarão da presa.
verses.en_web: Your rigging is untied. They couldn’t strengthen the foot of their mast. They couldn’t spread the sail. Then the prey of a great plunder was divided. The lame took the prey.
verses.en_bbe: Your cords have become loose; they were not able to make strong the support of their sails, the sail was not stretched out: then the blind will take much property, the feeble-footed will make division of the goods of war.

verses.en: And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity.
verses.pt: E morador nenhum dirá: Enfermo estou; o povo que nela habitar será perdoado da sua iniqüidade.
verses.en_web: The inhabitant won’t say, “I am sick.” The people who dwell therein will be forgiven their iniquity.
verses.en_bbe: And the men of Zion will not say, I am ill: for its people will have forgiveness for their sin.
